data.name: Mirjana
data.gender_notes: Mirjana is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Slavic word ‘mir’, meaning peace. The name Mirjana can be interpreted as ‘peaceful one’ or ‘lady of peace’ in various Christian traditions. The name Mirjana carries the meaning “Peaceful one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Mirjana usually hope their child will grow to embody peaceful one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes inner peace, calmness, and tranquility.
data.etymology: Mirjana belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Peaceful one.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mirjana total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

data.cultural_impact: In the Catholic world, particularly in the Bosnian region, the name Mirjana has been popularly used, symbolizing peace and tranquility. Mirjana is also the name of a visionary and a prominent figure in the Roman Catholic faith.
data.spiritual_significance: Aside from symbolizing peace, the name Mirjana in a spiritual sense represents devotion and a deep connection to God. It mirrors the spiritual pursuit of harmony, unity, and inner peace found within one's self and in their connection with the divine.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Mirjana: Derived from the Slavic word "mir," meaning peace, Mirjana embodies the serene and tranquil spirit of one who seeks unity and harmony with the divine. Her name invokes a sense of inner calm and steadfastness, inspiring those around her to find peace within their own lives.
